title: Kya rahaa khaimon mein Sheh kay ek udaasi rehgayi
body:
Kya rahaa khaimon mein Sheh kay ek udaasi rehgayi
Sirf ronay ko Mohammad ki nawaasi rehgayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Saj gayee Qasim kai tukddon sey udhar Karbobala
Maa idher betay ki dulhan ko sajaati rehgayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Cheenta tha shimr chaadar aur Zainab baar baar
Apni chaadar kay muhaafiz ko bulaati rehgayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Khoon-e-dil Abbas ka sab behgaya run mein magar
Dil mein bas ek baat Zainab ki ridaa ki rehgayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Musalmaano tumhaari ghairatain kya hogayi
Tum tamaashayee thay Zainab munh chupaati rehgayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaid mein Baali Sakina ko milaa Baba ka sar
Munh pey munh rakh kar jo soyee Maa jagaati rehgayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Maadar-e-Asgher na baitthi saaye mein Asgher kay baad
Saaye mein aayi toh zindaa laash baaqi rehgayi
Har tamaachey par Sakina munh pey rakhkar nanhey haath
Neel rukhsaaron kay Ghaazi ko dikhaati rehgayi
